records.text: I don't know. But the movie to which I refer is the Thomas Crown Affair. There are a lot of them. I think the best one was with Pierce Brosnan and wherein Pierce Brosnan, who is the lead character, executes a perfect art heist. I think he's taking a Monet.
records.speaker: Candace Owens
